customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (seed uuid or content hash).

name.meaning: Customer's full legal name as on the identity document used at sign-up.

username.meaning: Public Pocketwire username starting with @, visible to anyone who pays the customer; never a verification credential.

phone_number.meaning: Registered US mobile number used for sign-in codes.

date_of_birth.meaning: Date of birth on the identity document; the basis of the age check at sign-up.

ssn_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the Social Security number collected for identity verification; empty for customers who never verified.

home_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the residential address on file.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the customer profile was created (first sign-up), Eastern Time.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record, a content hash keyed on the customer.

verified.meaning: Whether caller identity verification passed on this contact; monotonically non-decreasing — once true it stays true.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human-handoff record, a content hash of customer and reason.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

wallet_id.meaning: Primary id of the personal account.

variant_name.meaning: Plan in effect, written as the official plan name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the personal account (see the wallet lifecycle).

kyc_status.meaning: Identity verification (KYC) status of the account holder; verified is required for every plan above Pocketwire Lite.

opened_date.meaning: Date the account was opened (sign-up date), Eastern Time; the anchor of account-age and new-account periods.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account was closed or declined; empty while not closed.

billing_cycle.meaning: How the plan fee is billed; not_applicable on free plans.

plan_started_date.meaning: Date the current paid plan subscription started; empty on free plans. Trial days count from it.

plan_renewal_date.meaning: Next date the plan fee is charged and a scheduled downgrade takes effect; empty on free plans.

pending_variant_name.meaning: Lower plan scheduled to take effect on plan_renewal_date; empty string when no downgrade is scheduled.

ledger_balance.meaning: Current personal-account ledger balance, identically the sum of the balance account's deltas in wallet_transactions (credits positive, debits negative); excludes debit card activity, which settles on the card ledger.

approved_weekly_send_limit.meaning: Weekly send limit approved on a limit increase, overriding the plan's weekly_send_limit; empty when no increase was ever approved.

limit_decision_date.meaning: Date of the most recent limit increase decision, approved or declined; empty when none was ever decided.

restriction_reason.meaning: Reason for the current or most recent limitation or security lock; none when the account was never restricted.

restricted_at.meaning: Moment the current or most recent limitation or security lock was placed; empty when never restricted.

restriction_lifted_date.meaning: Date the most recent limitation was lifted; empty when none was lifted.

recovered_date.meaning: Date the most recent account recovery completed; empty when never recovered. The post-recovery period counts from it.

txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the personal-account ledger row.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the wallet charter.

txn_reference.meaning: Reference shown to the customer in the app (payment, top-up or transfer reference, or ACH trace for a direct deposit); empty on rows that have none.

txn_date.meaning: Date the row was booked, Eastern Time.

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the movement, always zero or positive; the direction comes from the event family (in credits, out debits).

counterparty.meaning: Other party: the P2P recipient or sender username, phone number or email, or the direct deposit payer name; empty when not applicable.

payment_type.meaning: Whether a P2P payment was marked personal (friends and family) or goods and services; not_applicable on other rows.

funding_source.meaning: Where a payment or top-up was funded from; not_applicable on other rows.

recipient_status.meaning: For a payment sent: whether the recipient already had an account or was sent an invitation to claim; not_applicable on other rows.

transfer_speed.meaning: Speed of a cash-out, a returned cash-out or a top-up; not_applicable on other rows.

destination_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the destination bank account or debit card of a cash-out; empty on other rows.

fee_type.meaning: Which fee a wallet_fee or wallet_fee_refund row is; not_applicable on other rows.

billing_period.format: YYYY-MM for monthly billing, YYYY for annual billing
billing_period.meaning: Billing period a plan fee covers; empty on other rows.

source_txn_id.meaning: The original row this row derives from: the payment behind a fee or funding pull, the fee behind a fee refund, the cash-out behind a return, the invitation behind a claim or refund, the disputed payment behind a claim credit, or the originating record in another product for an internal transfer; empty when the row is original.

source_product.meaning: Pocketwire product on the other side of an internal transfer; not_applicable on other rows.

wallet_claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim record row.

event_type.meaning: Whether the row records the filing or the outcome of a claim.

txn_id.meaning: The disputed payment (foreign key -> wallet_transactions); one payment carries at most one claim.

reported_date.meaning: Date the claim was filed, Eastern Time; the anchor of provisional-credit and investigation timing.

claim_amount.meaning: Amount claimed, never more than the disputed payment amount.

resolution.meaning: Outcome recorded on the row; pending on a filed claim.

resolution_date.meaning: Date of the outcome; empty on a filed claim.

customer_liability.meaning: Customer liability computed at filing on an unauthorized claim; 0.00 on purchase protection claims.

provisional_credit_posted.meaning: Whether provisional credit had been posted on the claim when the row was written; false on a filed claim.

request_id.meaning: Primary id of the service request.

wallet_id.meaning: Personal account the request concerns (foreign key -> wallet_accounts).

request_type.meaning: What is requested: a weekly send limit increase, a review of documents submitted against a limitation, or recovery of a security-locked account.

requested_weekly_send_limit.meaning: Weekly send limit the customer asked for on a limit_increase request; empty on other request types.

request_status.meaning: Where the request stands; approved and declined on document and recovery requests are set by the review team.

decided_date.meaning: Date the request was approved, declined or withdrawn; empty while submitted.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

wallet_id.meaning: Personal account the card draws on (foreign key -> wallet_accounts).

variant_name.meaning: Card tier, written as the official card name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the card (see the card lifecycle).

card_form.meaning: Physical plastic or metal card, reusable virtual card, or single-use virtual card.

card_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the card number, as printed and shown in the app.

issued_date.meaning: Date the card was issued; the anchor of the activation window.

expiry_month.meaning: Expiry month printed on the card; the card works through the last day of that month.

delivery_speed.meaning: Delivery speed of a physical card; not_applicable for virtual cards.

custom_design.meaning: Whether the physical card carries a custom design; false for virtual cards.

replaces_card_id.meaning: The card this card replaces or renews (foreign key -> card_accounts); empty on a first or additional card.

issue_reason.meaning: Why the card was issued; the replacement reason mirrors the block_reason of the replaced card.

activated_date.meaning: Date the card was activated; empty while ordered. The new-card period counts from it.

block_reason.meaning: Why the card was blocked; none when never blocked.

blocked_date.meaning: Date the card was blocked; empty when never blocked.

closed_date.meaning: Date the card was closed; empty while not closed.

card_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the card ledger row.

card_id.meaning: Card the row belongs to (foreign key -> card_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the card charter.

txn_reference.meaning: Network reference shown to the customer in the app; empty on fee, refund and credit rows.

txn_date.meaning: Date the row was booked (authorization date for a hold, settlement date for a purchase), Eastern Time.

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the row, zero or positive; the direction comes from the event family. Holds and releases move no money.

merchant_name.meaning: Merchant or ATM owner as shown in the app; empty on fee and credit rows.

merchant_category.meaning: Merchant category from the card network; not_applicable on ATM, fee and credit rows.

entry_mode.meaning: How a purchase was made; not_applicable on other rows.

is_foreign.meaning: Whether the purchase (or the purchase a refund belongs to) was processed outside the United States or in a foreign currency.

atm_network.meaning: Network class of an ATM withdrawal; not_applicable on other rows.

atm_operator_surcharge.meaning: Surcharge the ATM owner added to a withdrawal, included in amount; 0.00 when none or on other rows.

hold_type.meaning: Class of an authorization hold; not_applicable on other rows.

card_fee_type.meaning: Which fee a card_fee or card_fee_refund row is; not_applicable on other rows.

source_txn_id.meaning: The original row this row derives from: the hold a purchase settles or a release releases, the purchase or withdrawal behind a fee, the fee behind a fee refund, the withdrawal behind a reimbursement, the purchase behind a merchant refund, or the disputed transaction behind a dispute credit; empty when the row is original.

card_dispute_id.meaning: Primary id of the dispute record row.

card_id.meaning: Card the disputed transaction was made on (foreign key -> card_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Whether the row records the filing or the outcome of a dispute.

card_txn_id.meaning: The disputed card purchase or ATM withdrawal (foreign key -> card_transactions); one transaction carries at most one dispute.

dispute_reason.meaning: Reason of the dispute; unauthorized is governed by the unauthorized-dispute rules, every other reason by the merchant-dispute rules.

reported_date.meaning: Date the dispute was filed, Eastern Time; the anchor of provisional-credit and investigation timing.

dispute_amount.meaning: Amount disputed, never more than the transaction amount.

customer_liability.meaning: Liability computed at filing on an unauthorized dispute; 0.00 on merchant disputes and auto-credited disputes.

resolution.meaning: Outcome recorded on the row; pending on a filed dispute.

resolution_date.meaning: Date of the outcome; empty on a filed dispute.

provisional_credit_posted.meaning: Whether provisional credit had been posted on the dispute when the row was written; false on a filed dispute.

membership_id.meaning: Primary id of the rewards membership.

wallet_id.meaning: Personal account cash redemptions are paid into (foreign key -> wallet_accounts).

variant_name.meaning: Rewards tier held, written as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the membership (see the rewards lifecycle).

enrolled_date.meaning: Enrolment date; membership anniversaries count from it.

closed_date.meaning: Date the membership was closed; empty while not closed.

points_balance.format: integer points, may be negative after a clawback
points_balance.meaning: Current points balance, identically the sum of the points account's deltas in rewards_ledger (earnings positive, redemptions, clawbacks and expiries negative).

tier_qualified_date.meaning: Date the current tier was assigned.

tier_review_date.meaning: Date of the next quarterly tier review (the first day of a calendar quarter).

below_retention_quarters.meaning: Consecutive quarterly reviews at which spend was below the tier's retention spend.

suspension_reason.meaning: Why the membership is or was last suspended; none when never suspended.

rewards_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the rewards ledger row.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the rewards charter.

entry_date.meaning: Date the row was booked, Eastern Time.

points.meaning: Absolute points of the row; the direction comes from the event family (earnings in, redemptions, clawbacks and expiries out); 0 on activation and fulfilment rows.

source_txn_id.meaning: The original record this row derives from: the card purchase (card_transactions) behind an earning, boost or clawback, or the redemption behind a fulfilment, reversal or courtesy credit; empty otherwise.

spend_amount.meaning: Purchase amount behind an earning or boost, or refunded amount behind a clawback; empty on other rows.

merchant_category.meaning: Merchant category of the earning purchase; not_applicable on other rows.

offer_code.meaning: Boost offer code exactly as listed in the boost offer catalogue (for example BOOST-FRESHMART5); empty on non-boost rows.

activated_at.meaning: Moment a boost was activated; empty on other rows.

redemption_reference.meaning: Redemption reference shown in the app; empty on other rows.

redemption_type.meaning: What the points were redeemed for; not_applicable on other rows.

cash_value.meaning: USD value of a redemption (cash paid, gift card face value or donation); empty on other rows.

payee_name.meaning: Gift card brand or partner charity name of a redemption; empty on cash redemptions and other rows.

expiry_reason.meaning: Why points expired; not_applicable on other rows.

referred_username.meaning: Username of the referred customer on a referral bonus; empty on other rows.

bonus_type.meaning: Which bonus a rewards_bonus row is; not_applicable on other rows.

bonus_period.format: YYYY-Qn for a quarterly milestone, YYYY for an anniversary
bonus_period.meaning: Period a bonus is for; empty on other rows.

business_id.meaning: Primary id of the business profile.

variant_name.meaning: Business tier held, written as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the profile (see the business lifecycle).

business_name.meaning: Registered or trading name shown to buyers.

opened_date.meaning: Date the profile was opened; the earliest one across the owner's profiles anchors the new-seller period.

closed_date.meaning: Date the profile was closed or declined; empty while not closed.

business_balance.format: USD, 2 decimal places, may be negative
business_balance.meaning: Current business balance, identically the sum of the business_balance account's deltas in business_transactions (credits positive, debits negative); includes funds under hold.

reserve_rate_override_pct.meaning: Rolling reserve percentage assigned by the risk team; 0.00 or empty when no reserve applies.

reserve_set_date.meaning: Date of the latest reserve decision; empty when a reserve was never set.

tier_review_date.meaning: Date of the next monthly tier review (first day of a calendar month).

below_retention_months.meaning: Consecutive monthly reviews below the tier's retention volume.

review_reason.meaning: Reason for the current or latest review; none when never reviewed.

review_started_at.meaning: Moment the current or latest review started; empty when never reviewed. The document response window counts from it.

business_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the business ledger row.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the business charter.

txn_reference.meaning: Reference shown to the seller in the app (sale, refund or payout reference); empty on other rows.

txn_date.meaning: Date the row was booked, Eastern Time (for a delivery confirmation, the carrier's delivery date).

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the row, zero or positive; the direction comes from the event family. Holds and releases move no money; a delivery confirmation carries no amount.

buyer_username.meaning: Buyer's username or checkout email on a sale; empty on other rows.

sale_channel.meaning: How a sale was paid; not_applicable on other rows.

buyer_region.meaning: Whether the buyer of a sale is in the United States; not_applicable on other rows.

fee_type.meaning: Which fee a business_fee or business_fee_credit row is; not_applicable on other rows.

billing_period.meaning: Month a subscription fee covers; empty on other rows.

source_txn_id.meaning: The original row this row derives from: the sale behind a fee, refund, chargeback, hold or delivery confirmation; the fee behind a fee credit; the payout behind a return or instant payout fee; the chargeback behind a reversal or chargeback fee; the hold behind a release. Empty when the row is original.

payout_method.meaning: Destination type of a payout or returned payout; not_applicable on other rows.

destination_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the payout bank account or card; empty otherwise.

hold_type.meaning: Kind of hold on a business_payment_hold row; not_applicable on other rows.

release_due_date.meaning: Date a hold is due for release; empty on dispute holds and other rows.

tracking_number.meaning: Carrier tracking number on a delivery confirmation; empty on other rows.

business_claim_id.meaning: Primary id of the buyer claim record row.

business_id.meaning: Business profile claimed against (foreign key -> business_profiles).

customer_id.meaning: Owner of the profile (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Whether the row records the opening, the seller's response or the outcome of a claim.

sale_txn_id.meaning: The sale claimed against (foreign key -> business_transactions); one sale carries at most one claim.

opened_date.meaning: Date the claim opened; the seller response window counts from it.

claim_amount.meaning: Amount the buyer claims, never more than the sale amount less earlier refunds.

response_type.meaning: The seller's response; not_applicable on opening and outcome rows.

response_date.meaning: Date of the seller's response; empty on other rows.

tracking_number.meaning: Carrier tracking number given in the response; empty otherwise.

outcome.meaning: Outcome recorded on the row; open on opening and response rows.

outcome_date.meaning: Date of the outcome; empty on other rows.

request_id.meaning: Primary id of the business service request.

business_id.meaning: Business profile the request concerns (foreign key -> business_profiles).

request_type.meaning: Documents submitted against a review, or a request to reduce or remove a rolling reserve.

requested_reserve_pct.meaning: Reserve percentage asked for on a reserve_reduction request; empty on other requests.

request_status.meaning: Where the request stands; approved and declined are set by the review or risk team.

decided_date.meaning: Date the request was decided or withdrawn; empty while submitted.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

advance_line_id.meaning: Primary id of the advance line.

variant_name.meaning: Advance tier held, written as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the line (see the advance lifecycle).

closed_date.meaning: Date the line was closed or declined; empty while not closed.

outstanding_balance.meaning: What the customer currently owes on the line, identically the sum of the outstanding account's deltas in advance_ledger (disbursements and fees positive, repayments, waivers and write-offs negative).

tier_review_date.meaning: Date of the next monthly review (first day of a calendar month).

consecutive_on_time_repayments.meaning: Advances repaid in full on or before their due date in a row; reset to 0 when the line goes past due.

below_requirement_months.meaning: Consecutive monthly reviews below the tier's direct deposit requirement.

past_due_since.meaning: Date the line most recently became past due; empty when never past due. Suspension and write-off periods count from it.

suspended_date.meaning: Date the line was most recently suspended; empty when never suspended.

advance_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the advance ledger row; on a disbursement row it is the advance's own id.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the advance charter.

advance_reference.meaning: Advance reference shown in the app on a disbursement row; empty on other rows.

entry_date.meaning: Date the row was booked, Eastern Time.

disbursed_at.meaning: Moment of disbursement on a disbursement row; empty on other rows.

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the row, zero or positive; the direction comes from the event family. An extension carries no amount.

source_txn_id.meaning: The advance (its disbursement row) a fee, repayment, extension or write-off belongs to, or the fee row a waiver removes; empty on a disbursement.

fee_type.meaning: Which fee an advance_fee row is; not_applicable on other rows.

fee_period.meaning: Late-fee period number, or extension number on an extension fee; 0 on other fees and rows.

delivery_destination.meaning: Where a disbursement was delivered; not_applicable on other rows.

delivery_speed.meaning: Delivery speed of a disbursement; not_applicable on other rows.

due_date.meaning: Original due date on a disbursement row; empty on other rows. The current due date is the latest new_due_date of that advance's extensions, if any.

new_due_date.meaning: Due date after an extension; empty on other rows.

extension_type.meaning: Kind of extension; not_applicable on other rows.

repayment_method.meaning: How a repayment was collected; not_applicable on other rows.

repayment_attempt.meaning: 0 for a manual repayment or the first autopay attempt, otherwise the autopay retry number; 0 on other rows.

waiver_reason.meaning: Why a fee was waived; not_applicable on other rows.

vault_id.meaning: Primary id of the savings vault.

variant_name.meaning: Vault tier, written as the official tier name; the same on all of a customer's vaults.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the vault (see the savings lifecycle).

vault_name.meaning: Name the customer gave the vault.

closed_date.meaning: Closure date; empty while not closed.

vault_balance.meaning: Current vault balance, identically the sum of the vault_balance account's deltas in savings_ledger.

goal_amount.meaning: Savings goal of the vault; empty when none.

goal_set_date.meaning: Date the current goal was set; empty when none.

lock_start_date.meaning: Start date of the current or latest time lock; empty when never locked.

lock_end_date.meaning: End date of the current or latest time lock; empty when never locked.

freeze_reason.meaning: Reason of the current or latest freeze; none when never frozen.

savings_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the savings ledger row.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the savings charter.

entry_date.meaning: Date the row was booked, Eastern Time.

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the row, zero or positive; the direction comes from the event family.

deposit_source.meaning: Where a deposit came from; not_applicable on other rows.

source_txn_id.meaning: Originating record of a deposit (card purchase or direct deposit) or the withdrawal behind a fee; empty otherwise.

withdrawal_reference.meaning: Withdrawal reference shown in the app; empty on other rows.

withdrawal_destination.meaning: Where a withdrawal went; not_applicable on other rows.

interest_period.meaning: Month an interest posting covers; empty on other rows.

goal_set_date.meaning: Set date of the goal a bonus was paid for; empty on other rows.

lock_start_date.meaning: Start date of the lock whose bonus was forfeited; empty on other rows.

paylater_id.meaning: Primary id of the Pay in 4 account.

variant_name.meaning: Pay in 4 tier held, written as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the account (see the paylater lifecycle).

closed_date.meaning: Closure or decline date; empty while not closed.

amount_owed.meaning: What the customer currently owes across plans, identically the sum of the owed account's deltas in paylater_ledger.

completed_on_time_plans.meaning: Plans paid in full with every installment on time, as counted at the latest review.

past_due_since.meaning: Date the account most recently became past due; empty when never past due.

paylater_entry_id.meaning: Primary id of the Pay in 4 ledger row; on a plan row it is the plan's own id.

paylater_id.meaning: Owning Pay in 4 account (foreign key -> paylater_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the paylater charter.

plan_reference.meaning: Plan reference shown in the app on a plan row; empty on other rows.

merchant_name.meaning: Merchant of the purchase on a plan row; empty on other rows.

entry_date.meaning: Date the row was booked, Eastern Time.

amount.meaning: Absolute amount of the row, zero or positive; the direction comes from the event family.

source_txn_id.meaning: The plan (its plan row) every other row belongs to; empty on a plan row.

installment_number.format: integer, 1 or more; 0 when not applicable
installment_number.meaning: Installment a payment, late fee, waiver or schedule change concerns.

payment_method.meaning: How an installment was paid; not_applicable on other rows.

reschedule_type.meaning: Kind of schedule change; not_applicable on other rows.

new_due_date.meaning: New due date after a schedule change; empty on other rows.

dispute_reason.meaning: Reason of a plan dispute; not_applicable on other rows.

dispute_outcome.meaning: Outcome of a plan dispute; not_applicable on other rows.
